item.title: AgentMail raises $6M to build an email service for AI agents
item.description: AgentMail provides an API platform that lets you give AI agents their own email inboxes, with support for two-way conversations, parsing, threading, labeling, searching, and replying.

item.title: Thinking Machines Lab inks massive compute deal with Nvidia
item.description: The multi-year deal involves at least a gigawatt of compute power and also includes a strategic investment from Nvidia.

item.title: Google gives in to users’ complaints over AI-powered ‘Ask Photos’ search feature
item.description: The option appears on the Google Photos Search screen and lets users pick which experience they want.

item.title: Legora reaches $5.55 billion valuation as AI legal tech boom endures
item.description: Legora, an AI platform for lawyers, is now valued at $5.55 billion following a $550 million Series D led by Accel to fuel its growth in the U.S.

item.title: Meta acquired Moltbook, the AI agent social network that went viral because of fake posts
item.description: Meta says that Moltbook's approach to "connecting agents through an always-on-directory" is novel.

item.title: YouTube expands AI deepfake detection to politicians, government officials, and journalists
item.description: YouTube's AI deepfake detection tool is becoming available to politicians, journalists, and officials, letting them flag unauthorized likenesses for removal.

item.title: Adobe is debuting an AI assistant for Photoshop
item.description: Adobe is also adding new AI-powered image-editing features to Firefly.

item.title: Zoom introduces an AI-powered office suite, says AI avatars for meetings arrive this month
item.description: Zoom is also introducing real-time deepfake detection tech for meetings.

item.title: Google rolls out new Gemini capabilities to Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive
item.description: The idea behind the new features is to make the apps more personal and capable to help users get things done faster, right within the platforms themselves.

item.title: Sandbar secures $23M Series A for its AI note-taking ring
item.description: Sandbar aims to ship the Stream, which can be used to take notes, chat with an AI assistant, and for media playback, this summer.

item.title: Yann LeCun’s AMI Labs raises $1.03B to build world models
item.description: “My prediction is that ‘world models’ will be the next buzzword,” AMI Labs CEO Alexandre LeBrun told TechCrunch. “In six months, every company will call itself a world model to raise funding.”

item.title: OpenAI and Google employees rush to Anthropic’s defense in DOD lawsuit
item.description: More than 30 OpenAI and Google DeepMind employees signed onto a statement supporting Anthropic's lawsuit against the Defense Department after the agency labeled the AI firm a supply-chain risk, according to court filings.

item.title: Anthropic launches code review tool to check flood of AI-generated code
item.description: Anthropic launched Code Review in Claude Code, a multi-agent system that automatically analyzes AI-generated code, flags logic errors, and helps enterprise developers manage the growing volume of code produced with AI.

item.title: OpenAI acquires Promptfoo to secure its AI agents
item.description: This deal underscores how frontier labs are scrambling to prove their technology can be used safely in critical business operations.

item.title: Anthropic sues Defense Department over supply-chain risk designation
item.description: Anthropic filed suit against the Department of Defense on Monday after the agency labeled it a supply-chain risk. The complaint calls the DOD's actions "unprecedented and unlawful."

item.title: Qualcomm’s partnership with Neura Robotics is just the beginning
item.description: Neura Robotics is going to build new robots on top of Qualcomm's new IQ10 processors that were released at CES.

item.title: Sandberg, Clegg join Nscale board as this ‘Stargate Norway’ startup hits $14.6B valuation
item.description: Nvidia-backed British AI infrastructure startup Nscale has raised another megaround of $2 billion.

item.title: Will the Pentagon’s Anthropic controversy scare startups away from defense work?
item.description: On the latest episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, we discussed what the controversy means for other startups seeking to work with the federal government.

item.title: Owner of ICE detention facility sees big opportunity in AI man camps
item.description: AI data center developers are increasingly relying on a style of camp popularized as housing for men working in remote oil fields.

item.title: A roadmap for AI, if anyone will listen
item.description: The Pro-Human AI Declaration was finalized before last week's Pentagon-Anthropic standoff, but the collision of the two events wasn’t lost on anyone involved.
